findings.title: Q1 matches literally and misses recognized variants of Customer success
findings.observation: Rule Q1 matches only 'customer success'. The knowledge base records 5 equivalent term(s) for Customer success that the rule does not recognize.

evidence.text: recognized variant(s): client success, customer success management, customer success manager, client success manager, CSM

limitations: Synonyms improve recognition; they do not establish competence.
'CSM': Also 'Certified ScrumMaster'. Only treated as customer success inside customer-success contexts.
The presence of a related term does not prove ownership of renewals or account outcomes.
findings.proposed_action: Add recognized variants to the rule: client success, customer success management, customer success manager, client success manager, CSM.
findings.expected_benefit: Applicants describing the same work in different words are no longer filtered out.
findings.tradeoffs: Ambiguous abbreviations can admit unrelated profiles; review ambiguity notes first.

disposition.rationale: Client success and customer success are the same job here. Exclude the CSM abbreviation per the ambiguity note.
